extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, USPTO disciplinary officials, and legal counsel
extracted.subtask_description: A USPTO Final Order documenting approval and entry of an affidavit of resignation and ordering the exclusion on consent of a registered patent practitioner, with attendant obligations for notice, publication, and compliance with post-exclusion rules under 37 C.F.R.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit of Resignation conforming to 37 C.F.R. §§ 10.133(b) and (c)
rubrics_metrics.description: The attached Affidavit of Resignation from Henry W. Cummings, Registration No. 22563, conforming to the requirements set forth in 37 C.F.R. §§ 10.133(b) and (c), is hereby APPROVED AND ENTERED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Approval and entry of the affidavit is contingent on its conformity with the specific regulatory requirements of 37 C.F.R. §§ 10.133(b) and (c). The order records the USPTO's formal acceptance of a resignation affidavit that meets those regulatory criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion on Consent (effective date)
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Henry W. Cummings be excluded on consent as of August tl../, 2008.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order sets the practitioner's exclusion on consent and identifies an effective date for that exclusion (document also bears an Aug 21, 2008 stamp). The order formally records when the exclusion becomes effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 10.158 after exclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that Henry W. Cummings comply with the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 10.158.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The respondent is explicitly ordered to follow the post-exclusion duties and procedures set forth in § 10.158 (e.g., client notification, transfer/custody of files, and any other obligations specified in that regulation). The Final Order does not restate § 10.158 but makes compliance mandatory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of exclusion to be given pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 10.159
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that the Director of Enrollment and Discipline, pursuant to the provisions of 37 C.F.R. § 10.159, give notice of Henry W. Cummings's exclusion on consent to appropriate employees of the USPTO and to interested departments, agencies, and courts of the United States, and to appropriate authorities of any state in which Mr. Cummings is known to be a member of the bar and any appropriate bar association.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director must notify a specified universe of recipients (USPTO employees, interested federal departments/agencies/courts, state authorities where the respondent is a bar member, and relevant bar associations) as required by § 10.159. This prescribes who must be informed of the exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of Notice in the Official Gazette per 37 C.F.R. § 10.159
rubrics_metrics.description: ORDERED that the Director of Enrollment and Discipline, pursuant to the provisions of 37 C.F.R. § 10.159, publish the Notice of Exclusion on Consent in the Official Gazette.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order directs that the exclusion be made public by publication in the Official Gazette, fulfilling the public-notice requirement of § 10.159.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service/notification recipients (cc and addresses)
rubrics_metrics.description: The order includes copies/cc to Harry I. Moatz (Director of Enrollment and Discipline) and to Henry W. Cummings at his address (3313 W. Adams Street, St. Charles, MO 63301).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document demonstrates formal service/notification practice by listing the specific parties and addresses to which the order and related notices are sent, ensuring record of communication to the respondent and internal USPTO officials.
